svg.aria-label: Diagram: you chat with shell3 in a browser; every tool call passes your hook gate before the agent acts through bash and edit on your shell; the agent delegates to project managers, subagents and cron jobs; every background completion is triaged by the notifier into a bell notification, a wake of the agent, or silence.
svg.text: ONE GO BINARY · ONE FOLDER OF PLAIN FILES
chat, jobs, cron, runs, status, files
the whole Unix toolbox, on your box
a brief + a manager, its shell in
EVERY BACKGROUND RESULT COMES BACK THROUGH ONE FUNNEL
so a periodic checklist only speaks up when something needs attention
